_meta.purpose: Canonical machine-readable domain-purpose taxonomy for FD-001 legal/IP and operator-surface planning. It records the target taxonomy and explicit evidence gaps without claiming DNS, trademark, renewal, or production routing completion.

current_drift_observations.observation: The legacy human ledger lists subdomain-oriented rows such as trust.oyatie.com, status.oyatie.com, api.oyatie.com, dev.oyatie.com, oyatie.kr, and oyatie.co.kr rather than this five-domain FD-001 taxonomy.
current_drift_observations.impact: FD-001 cannot treat the legal/IP ledger as production-grade domain evidence until the machine-readable taxonomy, registrar/DNS evidence, and legacy ledger projection are reconciled.

current_drift_observations.observation: API hostnames are mapped for API surface separation but do not encode legal/IP purpose, trust/status/AI taxonomy, registrar control, renewal ownership, or trademark evidence.
current_drift_observations.impact: API hostname mapping is useful implementation input but is not legal/IP domain taxonomy completion evidence.

current_drift_observations.observation: The FD-001 blocker audit records legal/IP domain taxonomy as a recoverable local governance blocker.
current_drift_observations.impact: This spec closes the missing machine-readable target taxonomy only; external control and projection reconciliation evidence remain required.

fd001_domain_taxonomy_exit_requires: docs/LEGAL-IP-LEDGER.md or its retired projection no longer conflicts with this taxonomy
specs/api-surface-separation.json maps public developer/API surfaces to oyatie.com and internal developer/API surfaces to oyatie.dev without contradiction
trust/status/AI public surfaces cite this taxonomy before launch claims
exit_rules.claim_boundary: This file is target taxonomy plus drift evidence. It is not registrar ownership proof, DNS proof, trademark proof, TLS proof, public routing proof, or production launch proof.

non_claims: Does not prove any domain is registered or controlled.
Does not prove DNS, TLS, CDN, status provider, trust portal, API gateway, or AI model-card deployment.
Does not supersede trademark counsel review or renewal operations evidence.
Does not authorize FD-001 production or hyperscaler exit claims.
